# bioexcel/biobb_amber/leap_gen_top

## Summary

Wrapper of the AmberTools (AMBER MD Package) leap tool module.

Generates a MD topology from a molecule structure using tLeap tool from the AmberTools MD package.

Nextflow adapter of the [LeapGenTop](https://biobb-amber.readthedocs.io/en/latest/leap.html#module-leap.leap_gen_top) building block of [biobb_amber](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_amber) 5.3.3.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_AMBER_LEAP_GEN_TOP } from 'bioexcel/biobb_amber/leap_gen_top'

workflow {
    BIOBB_AMBER_LEAP_GEN_TOP(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Input 3D structure PDB file |
| `input_lib_path` | no | lib, zip | Input ligand library parameters file |
| `input_frcmod_path` | no | frcmod, zip | Input ligand frcmod parameters file |
| `input_params_path` | no | in, leapin, txt, zip | Additional leap parameter files to load with loadAmberParams Leap command |
| `input_prep_path` | no | in, leapin, txt, zip | Additional leap parameter files to load with loadAmberPrep Leap command |
| `input_source_path` | no | in, leapin, txt, zip | Additional leap command files to load with source Leap command |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Output 3D structure PDB file matching the topology file |
| `output_top_path` | yes | top, parmtop, prmtop | Output topology file (AMBER ParmTop) |
| `output_crd_path` | yes | crd, mdcrd, inpcrd | Output coordinates file (AMBER crd) |
| `versions_biobb_amber` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_amber', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of LeapGenTop properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_pdb_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_amber container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_AMBER_LEAP_GEN_TOP' {
        ext.properties = [forcefield: '[protein.ff14SB,DNA.bsc1,gaff]']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `forcefield` | array | "[protein.ff14SB,DNA.bsc1,gaff]" | Forcefields to be used for the structure generation. Each item should be either a path to a leaprc file or a string with the leaprc file name if the force field is included with Amber (e.g. "/path/to/leaprc.protein.ff14SB" or "protein.ff14SB"). Default values: ["protein.ff14SB","DNA.bsc1","gaff"]. |
| `binary_path` | string | "tleap" | Path to the tleap executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
